value.account:
WHAT I CHANGED
- New orchestrator/workflow/resume_projection_integrity.py: ResumeScopePath, ResumeProjectionIntegrityError, audit_scope (one scope, read-only: steps rows, current_step, loop ownership + bookkeeping, call frames incl. caller/alias/bundle/status/lineage), plus the helper audit_call_boundary_frames used by reached calls and the v1 diagnostic builder. Lineage lives in resume_call_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage, next_unused_retry_frame_id, CallFrameRetryLineageError), loop bookkeeping validation in resume_loop_bookkeeping.py (exact reasons/messages of the spec), call-frame selection in call_resume_plan.py, root checksum recheck in root_resume_guard.py, sticky-error detection in resume_sticky_error.py.
- state_projection.py: ResumeProjectionValidationError, enumerate_resume_slots / resolve_resume_step_id / resolve_call_boundary (+ slot/resolution dataclasses), CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias (filled by lowering). Loop-local ids come only from the projection's own runtime_step_id/step_key APIs; no id string parsing.
- state.py: record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure patch only status, error, updated_at into the on-disk JSON (unknown root fields survive; fail_run not used); has_forensic_current_step.
- calls.py: execute_call in resume mode resolves the boundary once (resolve_call_boundary), selects the callee by the boundary's alias, picks the frame from the lineage (never mapping order), rejects completed-frame id collisions first (completed_call_frame_id_collision), runs the existing input/write-root/checksum/bound-input validation, then checksums+audits failed predecessors in ordinal order and the resumed frame via module-level audit_scope, all before _CallFrameStateManager exists. A child's projection diagnostic is returned unwrapped (never call_failed). _is_workflow_lisp_target now means frontend_kind == "workflow_lisp".
- executor.py: structural-root guard (checksum recheck, then audit_scope) before the prologue; child call-frame executors skip it; _handle_control_flow returns "_stop" and promotes the diagnostic to the run error for any step/loop result carrying it. loops.py stops a for_each at the failing iteration (repeat_until already stops). finalization.py keeps finalization.failure supplemental ({step, step_id, error: projection error or null}) and never replaces/downgrades the run diagnostic; a projection error arising only in finalization becomes the run error.
- CLI resume.py: audit after the root-checksum check and before observability overrides, session/process metadata, executor construction; exit 1 + stderr reason + envelope only; completed runs are not audited; a failing session close no longer replaces the outcome. report.py / monitor / dashboard: a failed run's untouched current_step after a guard envelope is shown pending, not live.
- Delegated and merged: duplicate/merged import alias detection in the classic-YAML loader (orchestrator/yaml_import_aliases.py, before build_loaded_workflow_bundle) and typed frontend_kind="workflow_lisp" on every Lisp-compiled/lowered bundle (build_frontend_bundle no longer overwrites it).
- Docs: specs/state.md section "Checksum-Compatible Resume Projection Integrity", specs/acceptance/index.md items 201-211 + proof routing, a capability-matrix row.
- Tests: new tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (85 tests), loader and provenance test files, and updates to existing characterization tests that asserted the old gap (stale ids/ambiguity resolved by mapping order, planner-level current_step mismatch, CLI mutation order). Existing tests that seeded legacy current_step rows without step_id got step ids; stub-bundle CLI tests patch resume.audit_scope; the adjudication sidecar test and Lisp single-step resume fixtures needed small adjustments (see below).

ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED
- max_iterations on the projection's loop nodes (to validate the declared maximum in enumerate_resume_slots): dropped because it changes the projection dumped into the characterization goldens; the auditor reads the maximum from bundle.ir instead and re-runs the repeat_until check with it.
- Auditing in the planner or only in the prologue: rejected; the CLI must stop before overrides/session writes, and the executor needs its own guard for direct callers.
- Recursive eager audit of every nested frame at root audit time: rejected; callee scopes are audited when a call is reached (spec ordering: after input/checksum validation, before frame creation).
- Selecting the frame inside frame_id_with_overrides: kept that method for direct callers but it now returns the unique open frame or a fresh id (never mapping order); execute_call uses the lineage plan.

JUDGMENT CALLS / RISKS
- Precedence between unknown_explicit_step_id and unclaimed_explicit_step_row: a row whose name the scope does not own is reported unclaimed (count 0) before id resolution; otherwise unknown/mismatch. Audit order: loop bookkeeping, step rows, current_step, call frames.
- A repeat_until terminal state whose loop-frame row is absent is accepted (lexical restore tests persist exactly that); a present but contradicting row is rejected. Active repeat_until requires completed_iterations == range(current_iteration).
- A failed lone frame of a non-Workflow-Lisp boundary is still the single resumable frame (as before).
- Because every Lisp-compiled bundle is now typed, directly compiled bundles resumed in tests take the Lisp default-resume route; I added tests/workflow_bundle_helpers.step_granular_default_resume for those fixtures. test_adjudicated_provider_runtime patches root_checksum_mismatch for the edited-source case because the executor now rechecks the root checksum.
- Two golden structural fixtures (stdlib_review_revise_loop, wcc_m4_implementation_phase_full_fixture) were not regenerated: they already fail at HEAD in this environment for path-dependent naming, so they still lack import_alias.

VERIFICATION
- Full suite: 47 failed / 4815 passed vs 48 failed at an untouched HEAD copy; the set of failures is a subset of HEAD's (environment/path-dependent ones such as nanobragg, post_wcc inventory, drain routing). dev-check.json selection passes (447). A real CLI run/corrupt/resume smoke exits 1 with the diagnostic and only the envelope persisted.

NOT COVERED
- No dedicated tests for repeat_until loop-contained call corruption (for_each is covered), nested failed-predecessor checksum mismatch ordering beyond the running-member case, or a Workflow Lisp .orc end-to-end resume; docs/index.md and the roadmap plan docs still describe the hardening as the pending selector. Nothing is committed.
value.summary: Resume now audits every persisted step, current-step, loop-progress and call-frame identity against the current projection before any effect, fails closed with the stable v1 diagnostic through the CLI, the structural-root executor and each reached call, treats it as a sticky non-routable failure, and adds the YAML alias, Lisp provenance, forensic-status and doc changes; the full suite shows no failures beyond the 47 that already fail at HEAD.
